lines: - Backend-Batch 16 (9 Dateien, alle voll gelesen, nur Huellen + `TALK TO THE HAND`): alle 9 `.ps1`-Zwillinge (`prerequisites-check`, `docker-build`, `verify`, `healthcheck`, `release`, `install-deps`, `generate-env`, `test`, `setup`) als `-ps.tl`-Port.
